legal_privacy_meta_description: What {siteName} collects, why, who processes it, and how long we keep it. Uploaded photos are deleted within 2 days.
legal_privacy_intro: {siteName} ({host}) makes short AI parody videos from photos you upload. This page explains what we collect to do that and what happens to it.
legal_privacy_collect_account: your email address, and your name and profile picture if you sign in with Google.
legal_privacy_collect_photos: the face photos you add to the band, used only to make your video.
legal_privacy_collect_videos: the finished videos, so you can come back and download them.
legal_privacy_collect_payments: Stripe handles checkout. We receive your email, what you bought and the amount, never your full card number.
legal_privacy_collect_technical: IP address, browser and request logs from our hosting provider, and the link or campaign tag that brought you here, so we know which links work.
legal_privacy_processors_cloudflare: Cloudflare: hosting, file storage and sign-in emails
legal_privacy_processors_google: Google: sign-in, if you choose Google
legal_privacy_processors_ai: Our AI video provider: receives your photos to render the shots they appear in
legal_privacy_processors_no_sale: We don't sell your data and we don't use advertising cookies.
legal_privacy_retention_photos: Uploaded photos: deleted from our storage within 2 days.
legal_privacy_retention_videos: Finished videos: kept in your account until you ask us to delete them.
legal_privacy_retention_records: Account and payment records: kept while your account exists, and payment records as long as tax law requires.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: We set two first-party cookies: one keeps you signed in, the other remembers for 60 days which link brought you here. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
legal_privacy_choices_body: Email us to get a copy of your data, delete your videos, or close your account. We reply within 30 days. {siteName} is for adults: don't use it if you're under 18, and don't upload photos of anyone under 18.
legal_privacy_changes_body: If we change this policy, we update the date at the top of this page.
legal_terms_meta_description: The rules for using {siteName}: obvious parody only, no minors, nothing passed off as real, one-time credit packs.
legal_terms_intro: By using {siteName} you agree to these terms. They're short because the service is simple: you add photos, we make a parody video.
legal_terms_service_body: {siteName} is an independent fan tool for making AI parody videos of the viral "Outstanding" Tiny Desk clip, for personal, non-commercial sharing. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NPR, Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson or The Gap Band. Tiny Desk is a trademark of NPR. The concert footage and the song stay with their rights holders, and making a parody doesn't move any of those rights to you, so don't sell your video or use it in ads. When a rights holder asks us to take something down, we do; see our DMCA page.
legal_terms_photos_public_figures: Public figures such as coaches, players and celebrities are fine for parody; some public figures may be rejected.
legal_terms_photos_no_minors: No one under 18, and no photos of private people who wouldn't want to be in it.
legal_terms_photos_rights: You keep any rights you have in your photos. You let us use them only to make your video.
legal_terms_usage_heading: How you can use the videos
legal_terms_usage_personal: Personal, non-commercial parody: post it, send it to the group chat, play it at the party.
legal_terms_usage_restrictions: Don't present it as real, use it to harass or embarrass someone, or put it in ads or endorsements.
legal_terms_usage_platforms: Platforms may mute or remove videos that use the song. That's between you and the platform.
legal_terms_credits_body_before: Videos are paid with credits from one-time packs. Credits don't expire and can't be exchanged for cash except as described in the
legal_terms_credits_body_after: . Prices are shown before you pay.
legal_terms_ai_body: The video model aims for a strong likeness, not an exact copy, and results vary with the photo. The model may refuse some photos; a refused video returns its credits.
legal_terms_refusal_body_before: We may refuse a video, remove content, or close an account that breaks these terms, and we remove content when a valid takedown notice arrives (see
legal_terms_warranty_body: The service is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, our total liability to you is limited to what you paid us in the last 12 months.
legal_terms_changes_body: If we change these terms, we update the date at the top. Using the service after that means you accept them.
legal_refunds_meta_description: {siteName} videos that can't be made refund their credits automatically, and missed faces are re-rendered at no cost. Unused packs can be refunded within 14 days; broken results are fixed or refunded.
legal_refunds_intro: You pay once for a pack of credits. Here's what happens when something goes wrong.
legal_refunds_failed_body: If a video can't be made (the AI model fails or refuses it), its credits go back to your account automatically. You don't need to ask. If the video is made but someone wasn't swapped, we re-render that part on our side, several times if needed, at no extra cost, then deliver the best version; that video uses its credits. If it's still clearly broken, see broken results below.
legal_refunds_unused_body: If you haven't used any credits from a pack, email us within 14 days of buying it and we refund the full price to your original payment method.
legal_refunds_broken_body: If a finished video is clearly broken (the wrong face, a frozen or garbled shot, missing audio), email us within 7 days with the video link. We return the credits or refund that video.
legal_refunds_broken_likeness: A likeness that's close but not exact isn't a broken result: the AI model aims for a strong likeness, not a copy, and we say so before you pay. The video follows your photos, so results caused by the photo itself (no clear face, several people in one photo, a cartoon or a screenshot) aren't broken results either. We clean up every photo before rendering, but we can't add a face that isn't there.
legal_refunds_ask_body_after: from the address on your account. Card refunds usually show up in 5 to 10 business days. Please email us before opening a chargeback; it's faster for you.
legal_refunds_no_subscription: {siteName} has no subscription, so there's nothing to cancel.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How rights holders and people shown in a video can ask {siteName} to remove content, and how to send a counter-notice.
legal_dmca_intro: {siteName} is an independent parody tool. If you own rights in something used here, or you're in a video you didn't agree to, tell us and we'll take it down.
legal_dmca_notice_work: The work you own and where it appears on {siteName} (links help)
legal_dmca_notice_contact: Your name, address, phone and email
legal_dmca_notice_good_faith: A statement that you believe in good faith the use isn't authorized
legal_dmca_notice_perjury: A statement, under penalty of perjury, that the notice is accurate and you're the owner or authorized to act for them
legal_dmca_notice_response: We act on complete notices within 2 business days and tell the account holder.
legal_dmca_likeness_body: If you appear in a video made here without your OK, email us with the video link. You don't need to send a legal notice; we remove it.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If your content was removed by mistake, reply with a counter-notice: what was removed, a statement under penalty of perjury that it was removed in error, your contact details, consent to the jurisdiction of your local federal court, and your signature. We forward it to the person who sent the notice.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: We close accounts that keep uploading content they don't have the right to use.
